scenes.title: The Band
scenes.headline: "Nutshell" is a song by American rock band Alice in C…
scenes.supportingCopy: "Nutshell" is a song by American rock band Alice in Chains that originally appeared on the band's 1994 EP Jar of Flies. Since 2011, guitarist/vocalist Jerry Cantrell dedicates "Nutshell" to Alice in Chains' late original members Layne Staley and Mike Starr during the band's concerts. Jar of Flies is the third studio EP by American rock band Alice in Chains. Jar of Flies was the band's second acoustic EP, after 1992's Sap, and it was the first EP in music history to debut at No. Alice in Chains (often abbreviated as AiC) is an American rock band formed in Seattle in 1987. Since 2006, the band's lineup has consisted of vocalist/guitarists Jerry Cantrell and William DuVall, bassist Mike Inez, and drummer Sean Kinney. Vocalist Layne Staley and bassist Mike Starr are former members of the band.
